text:
Maya: Noticed paid search CPL drift this weekend. Branded longtail traffic ate test budget.
Sam: How big?
Maya: Spend +60% Sat/Sun, conversions flat -> CPL +40%.
Priya: Do we have creative fatigue?
Alex: Could be. I propose immediate creative swap to webinar promo and tighten retargeting windows.
Luis: Which windows?
Maya: Test 7d vs 30d. Run 7d high-bid weekdays only.
Tanya: I'll draft webinar headings (3 variants) and CTA focused on "deep dive + Q&A".
Alex: I will push two ad groups: webinar_short and webinar_benefits. Rotate every 72h.
Priya: UTM template: utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=apr_webinar&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={creative}
Maya: HubSpot routing: tag as webinar_apr, route MQLs to SDR A. Luis add hidden utm_campaign field to form.
Luis: Will add by 12:15pm.
Sam: Pull 40% weekend search budget to weekdays (9-5 PST) for two weeks.
Maya: If CPL drops >15% after 48h, shift another 20%.
Alex: Jenkins job queued for ad changes.
Tanya: Landing draft in #marketing-review.
Priya: Dashboard card for CPL by daypart & recency coming EOD.
Maya: Thanks team. Sync 10am tomorrow to review results.
